name: Keep Angular components focused
statement: Keep a component responsible for one coherent view concern; move reusable presentation, orchestration, and data access into established components and injected services.
rationale: Focused standalone components are easier to test, review, reuse, and render efficiently than page components that accumulate unrelated workflows.

badExample.description: A page component owns unrelated fetching and formatting
badExample.code: export class DashboardComponent { loadProjects() {} formatMoney() {} openTaskEditor() {} }

goodExample.description: The page composes focused components and services
goodExample.code: export class DashboardComponent { readonly projects = inject(ProjectStore).projects; }

history.change: Initial Angular component-structure rule grounded in the standalone component organization used by Agent Studio and Quality Studio.
